overview: Grimling Raider Paths is the shadowed corridor where Grimling warbands enter Shadeweaver’s Thicket. Ambushes, raider camps, and corrupted wildlife make the trails dangerous.
history: Grimling scouts first discovered the thicket trails decades ago.
Warbands began using the paths to raid Vah Shir patrols.
Acrylia shards were found along the trails, corrupting raiders.
Shadow corruption seeped into the forest, mutating wildlife.
Seru scouts attempted to map the trails but were ambushed.
hooks: A Grimling warband prepares a major raid.
A corrupted beast stalks the shadowed trails.
A raider camp begins harvesting Acrylia shards.
Seru scouts vanish along the trail.
